title: readtable
summary: Import tabular text or spreadsheet data into a table.

gpu_support.notes: File import and table construction run on the host. Ordinary resident arguments gather transparently before file access.

description: `readtable(filename, ...)` imports delimited text or spreadsheet data into a table using name-value controls or an import-options structure.
behaviors: Supports inferred or explicit variable names, missing tokens, text type, row names, sheet and range selection, and import-options structures created by `detectImportOptions` or `spreadsheetImportOptions`.

Documented integer `VariableTypes` preserve all eight native classes. Decimal fields are parsed directly into authoritative integer storage, including exact `int64` and `uint64` values above `flintmax`, with class-specific saturation for out-of-range values.
The documented `VariableNamesLine` structural control accepts all eight integer classes and is bounds-checked without conversion through double.

Typed-integer values for implemented controls whose public datatype table excludes native integers are RunMat-only extensions. MATLAB compatibility mode rejects those forms before gathering or opening the file; ordinary residency still gathers transparently for host import.
Imported table variables retain their native double, single, integer, logical, text, datetime, or duration representation rather than acquiring a floating compatibility mirror.
